mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with a midline armada focused on long-range missile and weapon combat, featuring unique ships, weapons, and hullmods with enhanced range and resistance.

mods.name: Yuki's Tactical Display
mods.summary: Adds a tactical display widget to the combat UI showing fleet status, flux bars, and CR/PPT visually, with order issuance and optional enemy fleet display.
